scope: Genuine Android7.1.2 Rockchip GNUmake Android.mk native HAL build in thin reference tree. Top-level tapas aosp_arm/arm eng, explicit Cortex-A7/ARMv7/NEON/RK322x/Mali400 board variables, selected genuine BUILD_PREBUILT platform DSOs. Not source-built platform/BSP, full board product build, rendering or hardware validation.

final_fixed_incremental_build.note: Genuine version.sh regenerates timestamp headers on each parse, so version consumers of both HALs also rebuild.

prebuilt_DSO_scope: 21 actual official SDK API25 ARM32 system DSOs plus pinned Rockchip vendor libion; genuine ELF inputs, no generated stubs, no BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARY bypass. These DSOs are not delivered or selected into new product.
CRT_scope: Two actual pinned Bionic-source shared CRT objects reused via supported TARGET_CRTBEGIN_SO_O/TARGET_CRTEND_SO_O overrides; previously compiled with softfp Linaro6.3.1.

toolchains.note: Clang3.8 compiles actual unwind/compiler-rt Android.mk modules; GCC4.9 compiles HALs and links, real linker plugin used. Tool subsets, actual legacy ABI5 ncurses libraries and genuine Clang resource alias acquired without system-package mutation.

link_checks: actual pack relocation + strip + install rules
ELF32 ARM + exported HMI + no TEXTREL
unresolved: No source-built complete Android product or images.
No GPU/framebuffer HAL open, rendering/fences/ION/RGA function validation.
No real board/module compatibility or SD boot.
Legacy warnings remain, recorded in warnings.json.
